d: Ronaldo retires from international football. The Portuguese football legend Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football. The 41-year-old will no longer play for the national team. However, he will continue to play for his club in Saudi Arabia -- Al Nassr. Ronaldo first made his debut for Portugal in 2003 and is the highest goal scorer for the country at 146 goals. Hem Saroya explains on Vantage.
